plain_language.what_did_we_find: Two implementations of moving and replacing variables inside expression trees matched a separate named-variable model on all 10,000 selected records: 15,000 checked outputs per implementation and no difference. The records represent 5,091 distinct structural inputs. The trees use variables validly within declared contexts; we did not test whether they form valid typed Lean programs or proofs, or test other APIs.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes. The independently audited corpus includes 2,000 cases where a replacement variable could be wrongly captured by a surrounding binder, plus reusable checks for variable movement and replacement. It found no implementation defect. Finite checker agreement is not a correctness proof.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Retain the fixed model, auditor and corpus as a local regression asset for future API changes. This result alone warrants no external issue or contribution. The next queue item is a separate research question.

scientific_conclusion: Within the frozen, well-scoped syntactic fragment, both selected public APIs produced exactly the named-model de Bruijn output for every recorded stage. No difference was observed; no typing, whole-kernel, universal correctness or performance claim follows.

scope.validity: well-scoped syntax in declared finite contexts; no typechecking claim
scope.distinct_projection: operation, context length, de Bruijn source, de Bruijn arguments and parameters; excludes ID, ordinal, family, variant and named labels

observations.process_control: All scientific processes exited zero with positive RSS samples, empty stderr, no timeout or monitor error, and complete cleanup below the frozen 3-GiB ceiling.
observations.timing_limit: Recorded process times are not a benchmark and omit preparation and review time.

repair_history: An unsupervised Kiota adapter check failed and was repaired before science; the first source bytes and exact elapsed cost are unavailable and recorded as such.

Four selected scientific records appeared in prefreeze auditor tests; their exact bytes were preserved and adopted unchanged after independent review and deterministic replay, with no observer feedback.
The first RSS preflight was denied by the sandbox before a child launch; an unchanged actual-host retry passed and both attempts remain preserved.

recommendation.target: Lean Assurance Lab structural binder-operation regression package
recommendation.reason: The exact frozen corpus and independent model/auditor can detect future API or adapter changes; this run found no distinguishing case to minimize or upstream defect to report.
